title: Imperium - Imperium is now available in Simplified Chinese, Japanese and Russian
author: keaslenyt
selftext:
Hey everyone,  
  
Imperium now supports Simplified Chinese, Japanese and Russian, and so does the free demo.  
  
It's the whole game, not just the menus: the interface, the tutorial, the Codex, species lore and every tech, building and ship component description. Star names and AI ship names are translated too. Chinese and Japanese come with their own fonts, so the text renders properly on Windows, Mac and Linux.

All achieved with the help of Claude Code and Codex Astra working together. I'm so happy that I can now reach audiences that would be impossible before. I hope the quality of the translations is good enough, so if you are a native speaker of any of these languages, please feel free to let me know if anything can be done better.

Thank you!

comments.author: sirpalee
comments.body: Looks nice! Reminds me of imperium galactica a lot. Especially the second one.
